page.content:
Most complete T. rex, now at the Field Museum in Chicago.

How Sue connects

  • Item: Tyrannosaurus rex — Sue is a particular Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton, FMNH PR 2081.
  • Location: Field Museum — Sue is mounted at the Field Museum in Chicago.
  • Location: Hell Creek Formation — Sue was collected from Hell Creek beds in South Dakota.

What is Sue?

Sue (FMNH PR 2081) was collected on the Cheyenne River Reservation in 1990, later auctioned, and mounted as the Field Museum's flagship Tyrannosaurus.

Key threads lead to Tyrannosaurus rex, Field Museum and Hell Creek Formation.
